exercises.q: I look out of the window.
exercises.why: **гляжу** — гляде́ть (imperfective): to look; to look after, to take care of.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Don't look into the abyss. Otherwise, the abyss will gaze into you.
exercises.ru: Не смотри в бездну. Иначе бездна будет ___ в тебя.
exercises.why: **вглядываться** — вгля́дываться (imperfective): to peer into, to look or observe narrowly.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to glance at, to look at
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: гляде́ть — to look; взгляд — glance, look; взгляну́ть — to glance at, to look at; погляде́ть — to look, to glance.

exercises.q: Martha stared at her deeply, as if peering into her soul.
exercises.ru: Марта пристально на неё смотрела, словно ___ в душу.
exercises.why: **вглядываясь** — вгля́дываться (imperfective): to peer into, to look or observe narrowly.

exercises.q: Did you get a good look at her?
exercises.why: **разглядел** — разгляде́ть (perfective): to make out, to discern, to descry; to detect, to discern. Wiktionary: раз- + гляде́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

to look / glance back (at); to turn (back) to look at something

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to glance (at), to peep (in), to look (into), to have a look (at)
to glance, to give a brief look
to look out, to peep out
to peer into, to look or observe narrowly
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: загля́дывать — to glance (at), to peep (in), to look (into), to have a look (at); гля́нуть — to glance, to give a brief look; выгля́дывать — to look out, to peep out; вгля́дываться — to peer into, to look or observe narrowly.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to make out, to discern, to descry
to examine, to view, to scrutinize
to exchange glances, to look at each other
to look round; to have a look around
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: разгляде́ть — to make out, to discern, to descry; разгля́дывать — to examine, to view, to scrutinize; перегляну́ться — to exchange glances, to look at each other; огляде́ться — to look round; to have a look around.
